name: Motel conversion / renovation
summary: Renovation of an existing 1–3 story exterior-corridor motel (rooms, baths, exterior, systems), repositioned as a refreshed/boutique motel or converted to interim or permanent housing. Cost per key spans ~10x with scope: light life-safety/ADA work for interim housing (~$16k–$19k/unit in California Homekey projects) up to full gut with kitchenettes and MEP replacement. Hard cost here excludes acquisition. Sources: Homekey case studies, the Nehmer/HVS Design Hotel Cost Estimating Guide (2021 renovation unit costs) and RSMeans new-motel cost as a ceiling; the mid is a build-up, so verify.

typicalSize.method: Observed conversions: Best Inn 23 rooms (e26), San Diego Ramada 64 rooms (e27), Commerce 80 units (e9), Burbank Housing motels 20, 55 and 60 units (e10); HCEG economy prototype 90 rooms (e23). Mid 55.

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Economy guestroom ~303 SF net (HCEG, e24); Best Inn rooms ~250 SF (e26); plus bath (~40 SF) and a small office/laundry/lobby share, exterior walkways excluded → ~350–500 GSF/key.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: 1–2 story motels with ~1 surface space per room: ~25–50 rooms/acre (2-story courtyard plans at the high end).

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Existing motels typically park ~1 per room (HCEG economy prototype 100 spaces / 90 rooms = 1.11, e25); housing conversions for formerly homeless residents often need far fewer.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Scope build-up (2021–2022 evidence, expressed as 2022 $). LOW (life-safety/ADA/systems only): Best Inn interim conversion $19,026/unit (2021, e1) and Commerce extended-stay motel $1.3M/80 = $16,250/unit for plumbing, electrical, fire alarm, roofing and security (2022, e2) → $15k. MID (full repositioning): HCEG 2021 full room + bath + corridor renovation, economy $9.4k–$13.2k and midscale $19.7k–$26.8k per key (e4, e5) x1.18 GC markups (e6), taking only the ~55% construction share (rest is FF&E) at a midscale finish → ~$15k; + PTAC ~$1.4k, locks ~$0.3k, 5% accessible rooms ~$1.4k/key, systems/roof/fire alarm at Commerce level ~$16k, exterior paint/windows/doors ~$6–8k, site/signage/landscape ~$1–2k → ~$42k–$45k. HIGH (gut + kitchenettes/MEP replacement, e.g., permanent housing): Best Inn permanent conversion estimate $62,448/unit total development (2021, e3) ≈ $52k hard, plus sprinklers/unit combinations → $85k, capped near new-build replacement (RSMeans new 2-3 story motel $157–$173/SF in 2019 $, incl. 6% A/E, x ~420 SF ≈ $66k–$73k before escalation, e7). California evidence was not regionalized by hand.

perSF.method: perPrimaryUnit ÷ 420 SF/key (low $15k → $36, mid $45k → $107, high $85k → $202). New motel construction for comparison: RSMeans $157–$173/SF (2019 $, e7).

scope.notes: Renovation contractor price incl. GC and OH&P: interior demo, room/bath/corridor construction, PTACs, life safety, roof/exterior, ADA rooms, parking lot reseal, landscape and signage. Excludes acquisition, loose FF&E (beds, casegoods, TVs), soft costs, permits, contingency, relocation, off-sites, impact/tap fees, financing.

qualityTiers.method: Economy = light life-safety/ADA scope (low/mid = 0.33); premium = boutique-grade reposition with upgraded baths and exterior (~1.4); luxury = high/mid (1.89), gut renovation approaching replacement cost.

systemSplit.method: Derived from the mid build-up: room/bath/corridor finishes (09) and bath plumbing (22) dominate (HCEG room/bath lines, e4); demolition (02) ~8%; roofing/exterior envelope (07) and doors/windows (08) per Commerce scope (e2); PTACs (23); panels/wiring (26); fire alarm/security (28); partial sprinkler retrofit (21); parking/landscape (32); renovation general conditions are a higher share (01, 12%) due to phasing in occupied or small buildings.

lineItems.name: PTAC unit replacement

cost.method: HCEG 2021 economy PTAC direct replacement $1,039–$1,372 each (e12) x1.18 GC markup.

lineItems.notes: Carve-out of baseline; one per room.

lineItems.name: Electronic guestroom key/lock system

cost.method: HCEG 2021 economy new electronic key system $230–$332 per key (e13) x1.18.

lineItems.notes: Housing conversions often use fob access control instead (Commerce scope included electronic door fobs).

lineItems.name: Accessible guestroom conversion (roll-in shower)

cost.method: HCEG 2021 economy ADA roll-in-shower room $17,857–$28,000 per room (e14) x1.18. Qty ~5% of rooms (Commerce made 5 of 80 units accessible).

lineItems.notes: Multi-trade (doors, bath, plumbing); count set by the accessibility code applicable to the use.

cost.method: HCEG 2021 outdoor parking seal & stripe $375–$1,050 per space (e18) x1.18.

lineItems.name: Kitchenette cabinetry and countertop (housing conversion)

cost.method: HCEG 2021 extended-stay kitchen cabinetry $2,875–$4,500 (avg $3,840) per key (e19) x1.18. Plumbing/electrical rough-in for a new sink and range circuit is extra.

lineItems.notes: Switch on for permanent-housing conversions that add kitchenettes.

cost.method: HCEG 2021 extended-stay kitchen appliances $1,715–$2,345 (avg $2,066) per key (e20) x1.18.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Loose FF&E for a renovated economy room (bed set, casegoods, seating, lamps, TV, window treatments) ≈ 45% of the HCEG economy room+bath renovation totals ($9.4k–$13.2k, 2021, e4) ≈ $4k–$6k; new-build limited-service FF&E is ~$17k/key (HVS 2024 data, e28) as the high (boutique repositioning). Mid $8k.

pctOfHard.method: HCEG: design, interior design, PM and procurement ≈ 10% of a renovation budget (e22); add permits/plan check, physical-needs assessment, hazardous-materials and Phase I surveys (Homekey due diligence lists appraisal, PNA, hazmat, Phase I, pest, sewer inspection, zoning review), legal and insurance → ~18% mid. Excludes acquisition closing costs and financing.

softCosts.notes: For brand reflag add the franchise application fee and brand PIP inspection fees; for housing conversions add relocation, zoning/use-change entitlements and accessibility consultant.

design.method: Existing-conditions unknowns at concept stage before a physical-needs assessment.

hard.method: HCEG guidance for hotel renovations: 15% for a quick budget, 10% for a detailed one (e21); 20% high for older (pre-1970) buildings with hazmat or structural unknowns.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Hard $15k–$85k + soft 12–25% + FF&E $4k–$16k, excluding acquisition. Cross-checks: Best Inn permanent conversion $62,448/unit total development excl. acquisition (e3). Acquisition-inclusive Homekey totals are NOT comparable: statewide avg $147,974/unit (2020, e11), Commerce $204,000 (e9), Burbank Housing motels $262,776–$443,886 (e10); HVS redevelopment projects (building conversions into hotels) median $193,644 building cost (e8) represent heavier scopes than a motel refresh.

openQuestions: Need a rehab-only hard cost from a Homekey Round 3 / Homekey+ permanent-housing motel conversion with kitchenettes (sources/uses tables are often images in agency packets — San Diego Ramada budget was image-only).
HCEG 2021 renovation unit costs predate 2022–2024 escalation; a current HCEG edition (2025/2026) would update them.
Consider splitting into "motel refresh / reflag" and "motel-to-housing conversion" types — scope and code triggers differ.
